headline: Global Diesel Crunch Projected to Persist into 2027 on Refinery Losses
summary: Supply constraints in global diesel markets are expected to extend into 2027 due to ongoing Middle East conflict and damaged Russian refining capacity, analysts project.
why: Diesel is the primary fuel powering freight transport, construction, and agriculture; structural tightness directly feeds broad supply chain inflation.

impacts.name: Diesel / Distillates
impacts.why: Damaged refining infrastructure in key export hubs constrains middle-distillate supply.

impacts.name: Freight Logistics
impacts.why: Elevated diesel fuel costs directly inflate commercial vehicle and haulage operating expenses.
